info.title: Codefactory GitHub Service
info.description: Signed webhook intake and bearer-authenticated internal GitHub capabilities, including safe workflow summaries for the management portal.

get.description: Returns allowlisted workflow summaries for the management portal. Issue content, event payloads, and failure details are omitted.

post.description: Requeues the latest dead event for a task, preserving its payload and immutable GitHub task context.

requestBody.description: Provider webhook payload. Event-specific GitHub fields remain open; the signature covers the raw body.

200.description: Delivery accepted, ignored, or already handled
Leased event or null when the queue is empty
Applied to the deterministic task branch and created or reused its matching pull request. The operation never updates the base branch or merges.

post.description: Posts one bounded clarification question to the task's mapped pull request, replying to an inline review comment when a source ID is provided. A stable deduplication key prevents retrying the same question as a new comment.

200.description: Question comment created or an existing matching comment reused
At most 200 safe candidate paths from the task repository's current default-branch tree. Repository and installation are resolved only from GitHub-owned task context.

At most six requested regular text files from the task's current default-branch tree, or from the verified pull request base commit when its number and expected GitHub ID are supplied. Files retain the 16 KiB per-file and 64 KiB aggregate limits.

post.description: Revalidates the saved GitHub Project item and idempotently moves an open, active Ready task to In Progress before workflow execution.

200.description: Completion decision and the open GitHub update payload when completed.

error.description: The service truncates stored error text to 2000 characters.

FileChangeProposal.description: The raw JSON request body is limited to 2 MiB. UTF-8 file content is limited to 64 KiB per file and 256 KiB total.

summary.description: Implementation summary included in the pull request description when risk_summary is also provided.

risk_summary.description: Advisory risk summary for human review; it does not add a gate.

changes.description: UTF-8 content is limited to 64 KiB per file and 256 KiB total.

TaskSourceFiles.description: The raw request body is limited to 8 KiB.

issue_number.description: Issue numbers are not persisted by the current workflow summary store.

delivery_status.description: Webhook-delivery processing state; distinct from the task-event queue status.

status.description: Processing state of the latest normalized task event.

pull_request_merged.description: True only after a merged event is recorded; null means merge status has not been observed, not that the PR is open.

ci_status.description: Aggregate of the latest persisted CI event; unavailable means a completed query found no checks and is never success.

ci_complete.description: Completion value from the latest persisted CI event; null means no CI event is available.

head_sha.description: The resulting deterministic task branch head, whether newly committed or unchanged.

ci_head_sha.description: The PR head SHA used for the returned CI snapshot; null means the queried head identity was unavailable.

path.description: Relative repository file path. Absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, controls, duplicate/case-colliding paths, and credential/private-key files are rejected.

content.description: UTF-8 text content; NUL bytes are rejected.

Unauthorized.description: Signature, bearer, or dashboard-session authentication failed

InvalidClaim.description: The event claim is no longer valid

ProposalConflict.description: Task is not active or existing branch/pull-request state does not match the GitHub-owned task identity.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Webhook body exceeds the configured byte limit
